verdict.rationale: iTerm2's Smart Selection lets users Cmd-click to open URLs/paths and quad-click to select semantic objects like URLs and file paths, with Semantic History confirmed by community hands-on use for Cmd+Click opening paths in an editor, plus keyboard-based Copy Mode for selecting text without a mouse. Missing for 10: a first-party doc citation specifically confirming keyboard-driven selection of clickable links (only GitHub feature list and community anecdote cover this combination).
